title: Searching for news used to mean digging through headlines until you found the right one.
body:
Now, AI search is changing the rules. Instead of scanning lists of links, people are asking specific questions and getting direct answers. This shifts the focus from finding the right publisher to finding the right information.

But there is a catch. When you rely on a single AI summary, you lose the nuance that comes from reading different perspectives. You get the answer, but you might miss the story.

We built Headlinne to fix this gap. We use AI to help you find what you need, but we keep the original sources front and center. You get the efficiency of a smart search without losing the context that real journalism provides.

How has your news consumption changed since AI entered the mix? Are you finding it easier to get the facts, or do you feel like you are losing the bigger picture?
cta: See how we are rethinking the way you read at HEADLINNE.com.
